author: China Insights
description:
Learn how the fentanyl trade was reshaped by one man known as Brother Wang. See the connection between Asian suppliers and cartels.

This video traces the rise of Zhang Zhidong, a former Peking University speech champion who pivoted to a life of international crime. We examine how he utilized his background to build an efficient, lucrative pipeline for chemical suppliers, effectively linking them with Mexican cartels. This analysis is designed for those interested in the logistics of modern organized crime and the individuals who facilitate illegal networks.

By documenting his transition from an academic setting to becoming a kingpin, we clarify the specific methods used to scale the fentanyl trade across borders. Understanding the operational side of these drug trafficking routes provides context on how global supply chains are exploited by criminal organizations.
